# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Apr 23, 2026)

## OVERVIEW
Today's development focused on enhancing contract functionality, fixing critical bugs in the Supernode and ZK Game, and improving documentation. Key updates include support for X Layer's LiquidityController, enforcement of EIP-7825 gas caps, and significant progress on the `op-geth` decoupling initiative.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Contracts and Protocol Enhancements
Optimism's contracts received updates to support X Layer's `LiquidityController` in the L2CM upgrade path, addressing a compatibility issue where the `owner()` getter was removed ([#20114](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20114)). Additionally, a per-transaction gas limit cap was enforced in NUT bundle validation to reject transactions exceeding the EIP-7825 Osaka cap ([#20205](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20205)).

### Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements
Several critical bug fixes were implemented, including addressing code quality and documentation findings in `ZKDisputeGame.sol` ([#20236](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20236)). The `op-supernode` now distinguishes between transient and permanent `SafeDB` gaps to prevent unnecessary retries ([#20292](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20292)), and `op-acceptance-tests` were made more resilient to transient EL errors in the `Steady` sampler ([#20255](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20255)).

### Documentation and Testing Infrastructure
Documentation for NUTs was enhanced to detail a two-PR bundle flow and improve provenance error messages ([#20245](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20245)). Test coverage was expanded with new unit and integration tests for `ZKDisputeGame` ([#19955](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19955)) and an acceptance test for `SuperPermissionedDisputeGame` at initial deployment ([#20227](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20227)).

### Rust OP Stack and Interoperability Updates
The Rust OP stack was updated to `revm 38`, involving changes across `alloy-evm`, `alloy-op-evm`, `op-revm`, and `reth` dependencies ([#20169](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20169)). Follow-up items from the strong-consistency review for interop were addressed, with each item committed independently for easier review and reversion ([#20194](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20194)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Rust OP Stack Updates:** Multiple pull requests related to bumping `revm` to version 38, including a feature PR ([#20300](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20300)) and several reverts ([#20299](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20299), [#20298](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20298), [#20297](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20297)).
- **Supernode and Node Improvements:** A fix to raise the supervisor RPC timeout in `op-reth` ([#20296](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20296)) and a feature to add a `l1.beacon.slot-duration-override` flag to `op-node` ([#20288](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20288)).
- **Contract and Dispute Game Enhancements:** A refactor to replace implementations struct with a record array ([#20290](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20290)), a feature for L2CM authoritative registry ([#20280](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20280)), and improved test coverage for `CrossDomainOwnable3` ([#20256](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20256)).
- **Documentation and Testing:** Documentation acknowledging `Initializable` upgrade limitations in OPCM ([#20289](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20289)) and a feature to add pre-genesis super dispute game coverage to `op-acceptance` tests ([#20287](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20287)).
- **Miscellaneous:** A test draft PR ([#20293](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20293)), demo PRs for Canonicalizing the Karst Upgrade bundle ([#20284](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20284)) and NUT Bundle Update ([#20283](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20283)), a fix for `kona-proof-interop` to cache locally built replacement blocks ([#20286](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20286)), and a refactor to reduce `cannon-builder` to apt-only MIPS64 cross-toolchain ([#20253](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20253)). A feature to age run-trace game inputs in `op-challenger` was also opened ([#20252](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20252)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Deprecation of Req-Resp P2P Sync
The issue concerning the removal of req-resp p2p sync in `op-node` has been closed ([#14108](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/14108)). This aims to address sync problems associated with the older protocol.

### L2CM and Contract Compatibility
Several issues related to L2CM and contract compatibility were resolved. This includes accommodating differences in the `LiquidityController` contract for a 3rd party chain ([#20083](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20083)) and ensuring all L2CM tests fit within the Osaka transaction gas limit ([#20109](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20109)).

### Dispute Game and Interoperability Enhancements
Support for using super dispute games at genesis has been implemented and the corresponding issue closed ([#18729](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18729)). Follow-up items from the strong-consistency review for interop have also been addressed and closed ([#19561](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19561)).

### Flaky Test Resolution
A flaky test, `TestRelayWithInvalidMessagesSteady`, which failed due to transient EL dial timeouts, has been fixed and the issue closed ([#20254](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20254)).

## NEW ISSUES

### `op-geth` Decoupling Initiative
A major initiative to decouple the monorepo from `op-geth` and switch to upstream `go-ethereum` has been outlined with several new issues. This includes the overarching goal ([#20257](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20257)), migrating tests ([#20265](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20265)), making `op-service/sources` the OP-aware eth client ([#20264](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20264)), removing deprecated `ProtocolVersions` watching from `op-node` ([#20258](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20258)), creating `op-core/superchain` and `op-core/eip1559` ([#20259](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20259), [#20268](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20268), [#20267](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20267)), creating `op-core/params` ([#20260](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20260)), `op-core/fees` ([#20261](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20261)), and `op-core/types` ([#20262](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20262)).
